sections.name: File setup, params, create
sections.title: Setup and case helpers
sections.what: Loads the route handlers and the case service. Defines a params helper and a helper that creates a case with a random suffix.
sections.why: Likely reason: the random suffix lets each test run create its own case without clashing.
sections.watch_out: Keep the suffix unique, or case creation may collide between runs.

sections.name: synthetic document attachment
sections.title: Attachment isolation tests
sections.what: Checks that attaching a sample affects only the chosen case, that repeat attaches do not duplicate, and that invalid or cross-case requests are refused.
sections.why: Protects case boundaries and input rules.
sections.watch_out: A repeat attach must keep returning 200 rather than 201, or the first test will fail.

summary: Tests that approved synthetic documents attach only to the chosen case and that bad attachment requests are refused.
purpose: Protects the attachment feature from mixing data between cases or accepting arbitrary content.
why: Likely reason: prevents private text, file paths, or links from entering a case.
how: Creates two cases. The first test checks the first case starts empty, lists fixtures, attaches one, confirms a repeat attach returns 200 instead of creating a second record, and confirms the second case stays empty. The second test sends a cross-case fixture id, extra fields, an unknown fixture, and a cross-case document read, expecting 400, 400, 404, and 404.
inputs: Synthetic case names with random suffixes, and the fixture id fixture-legacy-a.
outputs: Pass or fail for each test.
risks: Relies on the fixture id fixture-legacy-a existing in the seed data.
debug: If the first test fails, check the attach response and then the fixture list.
